text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The teacher got mad at me because my test 
scores were terrible!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"If my next test is bad too, Sensei said 
it'll be one-on-one extra lessons, 
'desu'!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... I really need to study this-desu 
ne...

"Because of this incident, Taiki Shuttle 
was feeling down for a while."
